originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: Indian stocks had a big drop on Wednesday, which is the largest one-day loss since March. This happened because oil prices are rising, there's tension in the Middle East, and other countries' markets are also doing poorly. These factors led to many people selling their stocks, causing the big drop. Analysts think that what happens next will depend on a few key things, including what's going on in the world, what companies say about their earnings, and what central banks decide to do. This will help determine how the market does in the near future.

originalTitle: BofA cuts 2026 average gold forecast, sees long-term upside
simplifiedContent: Bank of America has lowered its prediction for the average price of gold in 2026 by 14%. This means they think gold prices might not be as high as they previously thought in the short term. However, they still think gold will do well in the long term. Other companies, like JPMorgan, are also being cautious about their gold predictions, and there's a wide range of opinions on what gold prices will do. The current price of gold is around $4,060 per ounce, and these predictions can help investors decide what to do with their money.

originalTitle: Palantir shares fall 4% as AI software stocks come under pressure
simplifiedContent: Palantir's stock price dropped by 4% because investors are getting nervous about companies that make artificial intelligence (AI) software. They're worried that people aren't adopting AI as quickly as they thought, which could hurt these companies' growth. This, combined with some investors selling their shares and a well-known investor named Michael Burry betting against the stock, is causing Palantir's price to fall. The drop in Palantir's stock is also part of a larger trend where investors are moving away from expensive tech stocks that don't have a clear plan for growth in the near future. This means that investors are becoming more cautious about putting their money into these types of companies.

originalTitle: Laser Power & Infra raises  ₹222 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO
simplifiedContent: Laser Power & Infra Limited is a company that is going to sell its shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Before the IPO, the company has already raised ₹222 crore from big investors, called anchor investors, by selling them shares at ₹214 each. The company plans to raise a total of ₹742 crore from its IPO, which will start on July 9, 2026. The shares will be available to different types of investors, including regular individual investors, and are expected to be listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and National Stock Exchange (NSE) by July 16. This means that after the listing, the public will be able to buy and sell the company's shares on these exchanges.

originalTitle: SBI Funds Management files RHP for IPO; issue opens on July 14
simplifiedContent: SBI Funds Management, a company related to State Bank of India, is planning to raise money by selling shares to the public through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The company has filed the necessary documents, called a red herring prospectus, to start this process. As part of the IPO, SBI will sell some of its own shares in SBI Funds Management, which means it will own fewer shares after the IPO. The IPO will start on July 14, 2026, which is when individual investors can buy shares. This is important because it gives investors a chance to own a part of SBI Funds Management, and it also allows SBI to raise money by selling some of its shares.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold slips $107, silver drops $3 as Middle East tensions escalate; Fed minutes in focus
simplifiedContent: The prices of gold and silver went down on July 8th. Gold decreased by $107 to $4,050 and silver dropped by $3 to below $60. This happened because of increasing tensions in the Middle East, which is causing concerns about inflation and interest rates. The value of the US dollar also got stronger, which contributed to the decrease in gold and silver prices. This matters because it shows how global events can affect the prices of precious metals, which can be important for investors to know.
